item.title: Story (IP) to Data (DATA) Migration
item.description:
Oct 8, 00:15 PDT
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Sep 28, 17:15 PDT
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Scheduled - Coinbase will convert Story (IP) to Data (DATA) from October 5 – 7, 2026. Story (IP) trading will be disabled on October 5, 2026. Please refrain from depositing or transferring Story (IP) during this time. Trading for Data (DATA) will begin following the migration on October 7, 2026.
